lines.gurmukhi: ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਕਛੁ ਸੂਝਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਇਹ ਪੈਖਰ ਪਏ ਪੈਰਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: bharam moh kachh soojhas naahee ih paikhar pae pairaa ||2||
lines.translation: In doubt and emotional attachment, this person understands nothing; with this leash, these feet are tied up. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਇਹੁ ਕਹਾ ਕਮਾਵਨ ਪਰਿਆ ਜਬ ਇਹੁ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tab ihu kahaa kamaavan pariaa jab ihu kachhoo na hotaa ||
lines.translation: What did this person do, when he did not exist?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਏਕ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪਹਿ ਕਰਤਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jab ek nira(n)jan nira(n)kaar prabh sabh kichh aapahi karataa ||3||
lines.translation: When the Immaculate and Formless Lord God was all alone, He did everything by Himself. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਕਰਤਬ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਨੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: apane karatab aape jaanai jin ihu rachan rachaaiaa ||
lines.translation: He alone knows His actions; He created this creation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੬੩॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak karanahaar hai aape satigur bharam chukaaiaa ||4||5||163||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, the Lord Himself is the Doer. The True Guru has dispelled my doubts. ||4||5||163||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਲਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee maalaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Gauree Maalaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਆ ਬਿਰਥੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har bin avar kriaa birathe ||
lines.translation: Without the Lord, other actions are useless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਣੇ ਇਹਿ ਓਰੈ ਮੂਸੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam karam kamaane ihi orai moose ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Meditative chants, intense deep meditation, austere self-discipline and rituals - these are plundered in this world. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਸੰਜਮ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਤਾ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਆਢੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: barat nem sa(n)jam mahi rahataa tin kaa aadh na paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Fasting, daily rituals, and austere self-discipline - those who keep the practice of these, are rewarded with less than a shell.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਚਲਣੁ ਅਉਰੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਊਂਹਾ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aagai chalan aur hai bhaaee oo(n)haa kaam na aaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: Hereafter, the way is different, O Siblings of Destiny. There, these things are of no use at all. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਇ ਅਰੁ ਧਰਨੀ ਭ੍ਰਮਤਾ ਆਗੈ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: teerath naai ar dharanee bhramataa aagai thaur na paavai ||
lines.translation: Those who bathe at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, and wander over the earth, find no place of rest hereafter.

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਹਾ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਓਹੁ ਲੋਗਨ ਹੀ ਪਤੀਆਵੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: oohaa kaam na aavai ih bidh ohu logan hee pateeaavai ||2||
lines.translation: There, these are of no use at all. By these things, they only please other people. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਤੁਰ ਬੇਦ ਮੁਖ ਬਚਨੀ ਉਚਰੈ ਆਗੈ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: chatur bed mukh bachanee ucharai aagai mahal na paaeeai ||
lines.translation: Reciting the four Vedas from memory, they do not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence hereafter.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਏਕੁ ਸੁਧਾਖਰੁ ਓਹੁ ਸਗਲੀ ਝਾਖ ਝਖਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: boojhai naahee ek sudhaakhar ohu sagalee jhaakh jhakhaaeeai ||3||
lines.translation: Those who do not understand the One Pure Word, utter total nonsense. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹਤੋ ਇਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ਜਿ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਪਾਰ ਗਰਾਮੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kahato ihu beechaaraa j kamaavai s paar garaamee ||
lines.translation: Nanak voices this opinion: those who practice it, swim across.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਅਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਤਿਆਗਹੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੀ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੬੪॥
lines.transliteration: gur sevahu ar naam dhiaavahu tiaagahu manahu gumaanee ||4||6||164||
lines.translation: Serve the Guru, and meditate on the Naam; renounce the egotistical pride from your mind. ||4||6||164||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee maalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Gauree Maalaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਧਉ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: maadhau har har har mukh kaheeai ||
lines.translation: O Lord, I chant Your Name, Har, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਤੇ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਿਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham te kachhoo na hovai suaamee jiu raakhahu tiu raheeai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I cannot do anything by myself, O Lord and Master. As You keep me, so I remain. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਕਿ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਾ ਕਿਆ ਇਸੁ ਹਾਥਿ ਬਿਚਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiaa kichh karai k karanaihaaraa kiaa is haath bichaare ||
lines.translation: What can the mere mortal do? What is in the hands of this poor creature?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਤੁਮ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਲਾਗਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਖਸਮ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jit tum laavahu tit hee laagaa pooran khasam hamaare ||1||
lines.translation: As You attach us, so we are attached, O my Perfect Lord and Master. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਸਰਬ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ ਏਕ ਰੂਪ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: karahu kripaa sarab ke daate ek roop liv laavahu ||
lines.translation: Take pity on me, O Great Giver of all, that I may enshrine love for Your Form alone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਹਿ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵਹੁ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੬੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kee bena(n)tee har pahi apunaa naam japaavahu ||2||7||165||
lines.translation: Nanak offers this prayer to the Lord, that he may chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||7||165||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ₁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag gauRee maajha₁ mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Raag Gauree Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਦਮੋਦਰ ਰਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: deen daiaal damodar raaiaa jeeu ||
lines.translation: O Merciful to the meek, O Dear Lord King,

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵ ਲਗਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kot janaa kar sev lagaaiaa jeeu ||
lines.translation: You have engaged millions of people in Your Service.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਵਛਲੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਰਖਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat vachhal teraa birad rakhaaiaa jeeu ||
lines.translation: You are the Lover of Your devotees; this is Your Nature.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਸਭਨੀ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: pooran sabhanee jaaee jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: You are totally pervading all places. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਪੇਖਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਕਵਣ ਸੁਕਰਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiu pekhaa preetam kavan sukaranee jeeu ||
lines.translation: How can I behold my Beloved? What is that way of life?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਾ ਦਾਸੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਰਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)taa daasee sevaa charanee jeeu ||
lines.translation: Become the slave of the Saints, and serve at their feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਵਤਾਈ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu jeeu vataaee bal bal jaaee jeeu ||
lines.translation: I dedicate this soul; I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tis niv niv laagau paaee jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: Bowing low, I fall at the Feet of the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੋਥੀ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਬੇਦ ਖੋਜੰਤਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: pothee pa(n)dit bed khoja(n)taa jeeu ||
lines.translation: The Pandits, the religious scholars, study the books of the Vedas.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵੰਤਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: hoi bairaagee teerath naava(n)taa jeeu ||
lines.translation: Some become renunciates, and bathe at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੀਤ ਨਾਦ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਵੰਤਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: geet naad keeratan gaava(n)taa jeeu ||
lines.translation: Some sing tunes and melodies and songs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: har nirabhau naam dhiaaee jeeu ||3||
lines.translation: But I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Fearless Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhae kripaal suaamee mere jeeu ||
lines.translation: My Lord and Master has become merciful to me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵਿਤ ਲਗਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਪੈਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: patit pavit lag gur ke paire jeeu ||
lines.translation: I was a sinner, and I have been sanctified, taking to the Guru's Feet.
